summary.text: Mitch Whitaker is a Republican state representative who has represented District 94 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mitchum Whitaker earned a B.S. in agricultural economics and a J.D. from the University of Kentucky.
His career experience includes working as a lawyer.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the House Judiciary Committee, the House Natural Resources and Energy Committee, and the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation Committee.
